title: Objective Progress: Push Boundaries and Learn the Secrets
description: Push Boundaries now shows, in every seat's column of the Objectives dialog, that seat's planet count against each neighbor as ours/theirs (12/10), blue with ▲ when ahead, red with = when tied or ▼ when behind, the neighbor's seat number in its seat color, and 'Ahead of N of M neighbors · need 2'. On a phone the viewer's own comparison is repeated in the card column ('You:'), since the player columns scroll sideways. Learn the Secrets of the Cosmos shows its holder n / 3 and names the systems that count. Mocked fixtures; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CU.

notes.title: Where the numbers come from
notes.text: Push Boundaries: ti4_engine::objectives::neighbour_planet_counts, the exact comparison the requirement makes (neighbors by transactions::neighbours, planets through the scoring view on both sides; 'ahead' is strictly more). The server adds the rows to table.objective_progress[seat].push_boundaries.neighbours. Learn the Secrets: ti4_engine::secrets::ship_systems_beside_anomaly, whose length is the count the requirement checks, sent as secret_objective_progress.lsc.systems. Display-only: not in canonical() or the fingerprint; no option id changed.

notes.title: Privacy
notes.text: Planet control is public, so every viewer gets every seat's Push Boundaries rows. Learn the Secrets' systems ride on the holder's own secret progress, which only that seat receives (projection_redaction.rs covers both).

notes.title: Map-shaped progress was missing in real games
notes.text: The server rebuilt the galaxy for these counts from the board tiles, which include the Fracture (not in the PoK catalogue) and a parked Wormhole Nexus at Mecatol's hex. The rebuild failed, so every map-shaped count (Push Boundaries, Intimidate Council, Distant Lands, Learn the Secrets, Threaten Enemies, Foster Cohesion) silently had no progress. placed_galaxy now skips off-grid tiles.
